$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside the entry's target (.ds-input-otp) and how to read it.

Group.$why: The group's 1 px stroke is an inset shadow on ::after, above the slots. It lays its slots out itself (no auto-layout gap or padding in code).

Slot 1.$why: Figma rounds the end slots 10 px inside the 8 px group; the code rounds them 8 px to follow the group's edge. The divider on the right is an inset shadow.

Separator.$why: The separator is an icon box (no auto-layout in code).
